summary: Iteration 93: tested PWA manifests, customer sign-in links (?cl=), attachments on all send endpoints, the shared RichComposer (console Messagerie, customer space, rider app, order thread, campaigns, broadcast), PopupGuard (Escape and backdrop), detail-back with kept filters/scroll, ?voir= inline details, document titles, and the Promotions subtitle. Backend: 10/12 pytest pass, 2 real bugs. Frontend: most features work. Found 1 CRITICAL XSS in renderMarkdown and 1 back-button trap on CustomerDetail (fixed by me). Scroll restore after going back is flaky. The WhatsApp campaign composer cannot be reached.

minor.issue: Console file filter only accepts data:application/pdf. The composer accepts .doc/.docx/.xls/.xlsx/.txt, but these are silently dropped (test_console_docx_txt: kept=[]). The rider and customer endpoints (_image_attachments) do accept data:application/* and data:text/*. There are 2 copies of the validation logic (DRY): send_message_core should reuse _image_attachments.
int(a.get('size') or 0) returns 500 when size is not numeric (e.g. 'big'). Use a safe int conversion.
body.image is stored without validation. There is also no URL-length cap, unlike _image_attachments (9.5 MB).

Storefront scope '/' contains /console and /riders. On Android, staff links can be captured by the 'Chez Dina' app when Console/Livreur is not installed. Rider manifest id '/rider' vs start_url/scope '/riders' (cosmetic).
access-control-allow-origin: * on /api/auth/login (no explicit origins + credentials). This predates this iteration.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL stored XSS. Text is escaped only for & < >, and the link regexes ([t](https?://[^\s)]+) and auto-link https?://[^\s<]+) let a double quote through into href="...". A customer message such as `https://x.test/"data-xss="1` or `[lien](https://y.test/"onmouseover="alert`1`)` injects attributes into <a>. Verified: a[data-xss] is rendered in BOTH the customer space and the console Messagerie, so a customer can run JS in a staff session. Fix: also escape " and ' (to " and ') in esc(), and/or exclude quotes from the URL regex: [^\s)"'<>]+.

useEffect(() => setParams({tab}), [tab]) pushed a new history entry on mount (/clients/ID to /clients/ID?tab=overview). detail-back (nav(-1)) and the browser back button therefore landed on /clients/ID, which pushed ?tab again, so the user was stuck on the detail page. Changed to setParams({tab}, {replace:true}). After the fix, back returns to /console/clients with the 'Actives' tab kept.

Flaky. Products: back via detail-back restored scrollY 900 once, then returned to 0 on a second round (1800 to 0) and in another run (629 to 0, q='escarpin' kept). Customers: 1500 to 0 via detail-back, 1500 to 1341 via browser back. Likely RCA: the scroll listener writes scrollMemo[keyRef.current], but keyRef is only updated in a passive useEffect. When the list unmounts, the shorter detail page triggers a clamp scroll event (scrollY 0) before the effect runs, which overwrites the list's saved position. Also the restore loop gives up after 2 s if the list loads slowly. Fix: in the listener use scrollMemo[window.history.state?.key] (React Router updates it synchronously), or save scroll in useLayoutEffect cleanup, and keep retrying until the content height is enough.
data-testid collision: the thread container is data-testid='msg-list' and the composer's bullet-list button is also 'msg-list' (testid='msg' + '-list'). Rename the container (e.g. 'msg-thread-list').

Imported in App.js but never routed. /console/campagnes-whatsapp renders Campagnes, so the 'wa-message' RichComposer cannot be reached. The campagnes routes are also declared twice in App.js (lines ~281-282 and ~298-299).

issues: The console MessageBubble renders attachments with its own code (no thread-photo testid, no lightbox) instead of the shared AttachmentsView. The same attachment looks different in the console, customer space and rider app.

Two attachment validators exist with different rules (send_message_core vs _image_attachments)

CustomerContext cl handling uses window.history.replaceState, so React Router's location/searchParams still contain cl until the next navigation. Harmless now, but any useSearchParams reader on the landing page will still see cl
customer_link tokens are valid 30 days, cannot be revoked, and give full account access to anyone the WhatsApp link is forwarded to. Consider a shorter TTL or single-use tokens
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Iter93 / TEST_Iter93UI customers, their conversations, 3 shared carts and rider TEST_ messages. All deleted or pulled afterwards (0 TEST_Iter93 customers left).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Console login UI: page.locator('input').nth(0/1) + button 'Se connecter'. POS is /console/pos (needs an open cash session for the toolbar). Rider login: button 'Se connecter avec e-mail et mot de passe' then rider-login-email. ui_seed_iter93.py creates a TEST customer + cl token + XSS probe message (run 'cleanup <cid>' afterwards). Retest: XSS (a[data-xss] must be 0), console docx/txt attachments, size='big' must not return 500, scroll restoration after detail-back.
rca of the issue: Back trap: CustomerDetail pushed ?tab on mount (no replace), so back returned to an entry that re-pushed it. XSS: esc() leaves " unescaped and the URL regex char classes allow ", so href breaks out. Scroll: memo key updated in a passive effect, after the clamp scroll event.
